description: What one run at boot that reached the stack came to.

against.description: When the machine started that the run came after, where it said.

not_back.description: Each service that did not come back.

port.description: The forwarded port before the start and after it, where the stack forwards one.

said.description: The sentence the run raised, where it raised one.

tunnel.description: Whether the tunnel came back with the stack.
